name: Verkada
summary: Verkada sells a cloud-managed physical-security platform that combines video cameras, access control, sensors, alarms, intercoms, and AI-powered investigation tools.
overview: Verkada provides a cloud-managed physical-security platform for enterprises, schools, and other organizations. It brings video, access control, sensors, alarms, and intercoms into one software environment.

facts.label: Reported valuation

bull_case: A unified cloud platform can replace fragmented physical-security systems, while AI search and investigation tools create a more differentiated workflow for customers.
bear_case: The company operates in a regulated, reputation-sensitive category where privacy, security failures, or public-sector procurement cycles can slow adoption.
latest_round: December 2025 CapitalG investment: $5.8B valuation; amount undisclosed
directory_notes: Watch for bookings growth, AI product adoption, and public-market readiness.

intelligence.description: Verkada provides cloud-managed physical-security products and software for enterprise customers.
company: Verkada builds cloud-managed physical-security products that combine video cameras, access control, sensors, alarms, intercoms, and software. Its platform is designed to replace disconnected on-premise systems with a unified, remotely managed operating layer.

In December 2025, Verkada said a CapitalG-led investment valued the company at $5.8 billion. The company said it had surpassed $1 billion in annualized bookings and had more than two million devices deployed across 171 countries.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Verkada is a test case for applying cloud software and AI to physical infrastructure rather than only digital workflows. Its scale makes it a notable private-company benchmark in security technology and enterprise hardware-enabled software.

changed.text: CapitalG led an investment valuing Verkada at $5.8 billion.

takeaways: Verkada brings multiple physical-security products into one cloud-managed platform.
CapitalG led an investment that valued the company at $5.8 billion in December 2025.
Verkada reported more than $1 billion in annualized bookings at that time.
The next questions are whether AI features deepen the product moat and whether growth supports a future public listing.
